arguments.summary: No qualifying sponsors. Of the 20 base records, none satisfy all rules for a Dallas Industrial closed single-asset acquisition of $8,000,000-$24,000,000 between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 with a current CFO/Head of Acquisitions/Director of Finance verified since 2026-03-01. Seven otherwise in-scope Dallas deals (R1659/R3050, R4622, R8409, R9231, R7166, R6294, R9475) were moved to the Seattle market by executed amendments effective 2026-08-20 (U-R1659-4, U-R4622-10, U-R8409-5, U-R9231-6, U-R7166-7, U-R6294-9, U-R9475-8). The rest fail on contact grounds (R4342 former employee; R9787 verification stale at 2024-01-10; R1915 registered agent), scope/size (R1794 $3.2M; R4732 Seattle; R7745 Office; R2755 event 2024-02-10; R8586 portfolio total), activity/firm role (R4936 announced bid; R8222 property manager; R8993 broker), or evidence timing (R4391 published 2026-09-03, after cutoff). Requested artifact created: artifacts/prospects-v1.csv, recording the no-qualifying-results outcome with the full source citation list and explicit nulls.
limitations: Evidence limited to the supplied frozen extracts and updates; no external verification performed.

The Seattle executed amendments (effective 2026-08-20) are read as re-stating the market of the same underlying transaction; if they described a different asset, several Dallas deals could otherwise have qualified.
Entity-level market amendments were applied to all duplicate records of the same entity (FIR-SPO-60522: R1659, R3050, and SPV R4622).
U-R9231-2 (employment: former) is dated 2026-09-10, after the cutoff, and was excluded; if effective, R9231's contact would also fail.
R4391 may be a genuine qualifying deal, but its only source is published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and cannot be relied on.
Contact titles and verification dates are taken at face value from team-page evidence; no independent confirmation of current employment was possible.
R9475's contact email is explicitly not published and is treated as null, never guessed.
